purpose: Evaluate the frozen E5 risk-controlled detector once on a semantically matched authentic-camera source and generator family absent from E5 development, without retraining, threshold changes, image cherry-picking, or model reselection.
research_claim_limit: A pass supports generalisation to one new authentic source and one unseen commercial generator under the frozen conditions. It does not establish universal AI-image detection or production safety.

external_dataset.benchmark_name: Synthbuster v1 with RAISE-1k real photographs
external_dataset.paper_title: Synthbuster: Towards Detection of Diffusion Model Generated Images
external_dataset.usage: Non-commercial research and educational evaluation only; cite both Synthbuster and RAISE.

synthetic.reason_selected: Firefly is absent from CIFAKE Stable Diffusion and SID-Set FLUX development, and is not the organiser COCO/DALL-E demonstration subset.

real.source_description: Camera photographs from the RAISE digital-image-forensics dataset.

external_dataset.semantic_matching: Synthbuster generated one image per RAISE-1k photograph from descriptions derived from that photograph, reducing semantic source-label confounding without making pixel-level pairs.

acquisition_and_integrity.synthetic_archive_policy: Prefer HTTP range extraction of only synthbuster/firefly entries. Validate every selected ZIP entry CRC and record each extracted file SHA-256. The published full-archive MD5 remains provenance and is mandatory only if the complete 12.4 GB archive is downloaded.
acquisition_and_integrity.real_archive_policy: Validate the complete real_RAISE_1k.zip MD5 before extraction unless range-only extraction is used; range-only extraction must validate every ZIP entry CRC and record each extracted file SHA-256.
acquisition_and_integrity.valid_image_rule: Every expected file must decode with Pillow, convert to RGB, have positive dimensions, and contain finite pixels.
acquisition_and_integrity.count_rule: Require exactly 1000 valid real and 1000 valid Firefly images. Any missing or corrupt image aborts the evaluation; no substitute source or manually selected replacement is allowed.
acquisition_and_integrity.deduplication_rule: Byte-content SHA-256 values must be unique within the external set and absent from CIFAKE, E4/E5 SID development, and the prior Section 4 SID/FLUX audit. Any overlap is a fatal protocol violation.
acquisition_and_integrity.public_outputs: Code, protocol, aggregate metrics, non-image figures, and citations only.

representation.note: Only the frozen OpenCLIP preprocessing and the registered evaluation transforms may alter pixels.

frozen_success_criteria.scope: Every real/AI class-by-condition group in primary_claim_conditions; additional stress conditions are mandatory reporting but do not change the frozen pass decision.
frozen_success_criteria.failure_rule: Report E5 as not externally validated on this one-time benchmark. Do not retrain, alter thresholds, replace Firefly or RAISE, remove difficult images, or search another external dataset for a favourable result.

reporting.binary_e5_threshold_role: Scientific benchmark only; never a deployment-safety claim.
required_metrics: real-to-AI confident error and Wilson interval
AI-to-real confident error and Wilson interval
confusion counts by class and condition
